description: This file declares the StandardCalculatorViewModel class, which is a ViewModel component for a calculator application. It includes properties, methods, and event handlers related to calculator display, input, modes, and memory management, and references external components such as display tokens, history, and snapshots.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class implementing INotifyPropertyChanged, serving as the ViewModel for the calculator's standard mode, managing display properties, modes, input, and memory interactions.

classes.name: ButtonInfo
classes.description: A value struct representing information about calculator buttons, including button ID and whether it can send negate commands.

methods.name: UpdateOperand
methods.description: Updates the operand at a specified position with provided text.

methods.name: OnCopyCommand
methods.description: Handles the copy command triggered from the UI.

methods.name: OnPasteCommand
methods.description: Handles the paste command triggered from the UI.

methods.name: OnButtonPressed
methods.description: Handles the event when a calculator button is pressed.

methods.name: ResetCalcManager
methods.description: Resets the calculator manager, optionally clearing memory.

methods.name: SendCommandToCalcManager
methods.description: Sends a specific command to the calculator manager.
